subject: Status: baselines done, QAOA pilot read
body:
Status on the evaluation.

Baselines: with the bruteforce method we factor test integers reliably up to the low-30s bitsize range; runtime is dominated by the lattice search and results are stable across seeds.

QAOA pilot: at qaoa_depth 2 the sampler recovers usable low-energy states on maybe half the seeds for 16-20 bit inputs, and outcomes are very sensitive to the precision_parameter — small changes flip success to failure. Honest read: nothing yet contradicts the skeptical takes on this method's scaling, and our report should say so plainly.

Risk for June: if the depth>4 sweeps behave like the pilot, most of the reserved capacity produces null results — still a publishable answer, but we should pre-agree the framing with Lucia so the report can't be spun as a capability claim.

Halima
